question: In December 2021, the ________ approved a $500 million loan to the Government of India to help improve the quality of the country’s school education and mitigate the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic on the students’ learning.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asian Development Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Asian Development Bank (ADB) approved a $500 million loan to the Government of India in December 2021 to help improve the quality of the country's school education and mitigate the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the students' learning.
 
• The loan will be used to support India's flagship education program,** Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan**, which aims to improve the quality of school education across the country.
 
• The loan will also help in providing **additional support to students and teachers affected by the COVID-19 pandemic**, including the provision of digital devices and internet connectivity.
 
• ADB has been working closely with the Government of India to support its efforts in responding to the COVID-19 pandemic and **mitigating its impact on the country's economy and people**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Asian Development Bank**

 
• The Asian Development Bank is a regional development bank established on 19 December 1966.
 
• Which is headquartered in the Ortigas Center located in the city of Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines.
 
• The company also maintains 31 field offices around the world to promote social and economic development in Asia.
 
 
• Headquarters: Mandaluyong, Philippines
 
• Founded: 19 December 1966
 
• Motto: ADB is committed to achieving a prosperous, inclusive, resilient, and sustainable Asia & the Pacific while sustaining its efforts to eradicate extreme poverty.
